nota: Lab settings (editable). Inputs: the history/opening-positions file from LEDGER_CSV (default sample_data/ledger.csv) and the investments ledger files listed in ledger_files (paths relative to ledger_dir, or to the project root when ledger_dir is empty; the env var INVESTMENTS_LEDGER_CSV overrides the list). An entry can be a path or {"path": ..., "titular": ...}. Rows whose platform is in excluded_platforms are left out of the Lab but explain reconciliation gaps ('esperada_excluida'); when included_platforms is not empty, any other platform is reported as a row error.
